components.text:
Circle: medium circle, ritual chalk.

Makes The Cure: one drink removes every vampire, werewolf and species layer from whoever drinks it.
Anyone can perform it, but a desiccated Original (or Original hybrid) player must be within 6 blocks of the centre, a little wider than the circle.
Making The Cure calls Rebekah to hunt whoever made it, a short while after. Without a desiccated Original the rite is refused and the ingredients come back.
